title: 麻烦状况与情绪表达
description: 用地道表达描述压力、失误、困境和情绪恢复。

data.english: I have been swamped all day.
This really threw me for a loop.
I think I messed things up.
Do not add fuel to the fire right now.

data.chinese: 我们陷入了进退两难的境地。
data.english: We are caught between a rock and a hard place.
It is just a storm in a teacup.

data.chinese: 我需要一点时间冷静下来。
data.english: I need a little time to cool off.
Do not take it out on me.

data.chinese: 好在最糟糕的阶段已经过去了。
data.english: At least the worst is behind us.

data.chinese: 睡一觉以后心情会好些的。
data.english: Things will feel better after a good night's sleep.
